sentence: It is I, the boy answered.
reference_translation_zh: “就是我”，那男孩答道。

sentence: Let's go Hiking across France.
reference_translation_zh: 让我们去法国徒步旅行吧。

sentence: Maize is another word for corn
reference_translation_zh: 玉米是玉米的另一种说法
note: 'maize' and 'corn' are rendered as the same Chinese word, so the sentence becomes a tautology.

sentence: Most of the nightlife in the town is centred on beachfront spots.
reference_translation_zh: 镇上的夜生活大多集中在海滨景点。

sentence: He was ludicrously fast on a bike.
reference_translation_zh: 他骑自行车的速度快得可笑。
note: 'ludicrously fast' is rendered as 'laughably fast', a poor word choice; 'absurdly fast' would fit.

sentence: A new movie is shown for the first time in the cinema.
reference_translation_zh: 一部新电影首次在电影院上映。

sentence: The Royal Court of Justice is based in the capital Thimphu.
reference_translation_zh: 皇家法院总部设在首都廷布。

sentence: It is also popular among tourists, people that like to swim and bird watchers.
reference_translation_zh: 它在游客，喜欢游泳的人和观鸟者中也很受欢迎。

sentence: He stood irresolute for a moment and then scrambled out of the pit.
reference_translation_zh: 他犹豫不决地站了一会儿，然后从坑里爬了出来。

primary_accent: India and South Asia (India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka)
sentence: To escape from the smoke, and fall into the fire.
reference_translation_zh: 逃离烟雾，掉进火里。

sentence: He has also worked as a teacher and translator.
reference_translation_zh: 同时他也是一位教师和翻译。
note: 'has worked as' (formerly served as) is rendered as 'is also', shifting the tense.

sentence: He shook his head.
reference_translation_zh: 他摇了摇头。

sentence: Jeez, you look stoned!
reference_translation_zh: 天哪，你看起来醉了！
note: 'stoned' (under the influence of drugs) is rendered as 'drunk' (from alcohol).

sentence: Fortune favours the brave.
reference_translation_zh: 天佑勇者。

sentence: Curiosity killed the cat; Satisfaction brought it back.
reference_translation_zh: 好奇心虽然杀死了猫，但好奇心得到满足后却可以让它复活。

primary_accent: India and South Asia (India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka)
sentence: “Tell me, tell me!” cried Noah.
reference_translation_zh: Noah 哭着说：“告诉我，告诉我！”

primary_accent: India and South Asia (India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka)
sentence: A stone flounder is the textbook definition of effective camouflage.
reference_translation_zh: 石质比目鱼教科书般定义了何为有效伪装。
note: Species name mistranslated: 'stone flounder' (a flatfish species) is rendered literally as 'flounder made of stone'.

sentence: People from all over the world have passed through this village, son, said his father.
reference_translation_zh: “孩子，世界各地的人都经过这个村庄。”他的父亲说。

sentence: Cheers mate, he said to the driver as he left the taxi.
reference_translation_zh: “干杯，伙计”，他离开出租车时对司机说。
note: 'Cheers' (here, 'thanks') is rendered as a drinking toast.

sentence: He is also a former Vice Chairman of the Senate Education Committee.
reference_translation_zh: 他也是前参议院教育委员会副主席。
